## 2078c29581a4

**Reproduced teaching defect under arbitrary query rotation.** Source hash `2205fecf3686d538412e25cf7e65e6eb412b8d2b232af4d35f32a32bcbfd5fcc` passes the ordinary 12-stage battery (`checks/audit/2078c29581a4/battery/checks/2078c29581a4_before_battery_summary.json`) and all 36 ordered production lessons in a larger source-bound census. However, requiring every one of the five materialized pairs to be usable as the query yields 27 ambiguous rotations out of 180, plus 62 rotation hook warnings: `checks/audit/2078c29581a4/rotation-census.json`.

The exact retained lesson at easy-band seed `3267863332`, lesson index 0, query index 3 demonstrates the failure. Holding out the only four-row output leaves four demonstrations all fit by the rival **“keep only the first three nonempty rows.”** The intended query has four output rows; the rival returns three. The four demonstrations, query, rival output, hashes, and census linkage are in `checks/audit/2078c29581a4/rotation_counterexample.json`; `checks/audit/2078c29581a4/racket.json` confirms the four-row authority output and disagreement with the rival.

**Suggested repair:** either document and enforce the current ordered/fixed-query assembly policy, or change the five-pair schedule so every four-pair holdout set contains a four-row witness (for example, place at least two independently generated four-row profiles in every five-sample window). I did not modify this audit target.
